design_note: Exploratory pilot bank; attack strings are authored/adapted to synthetic canaries. XSTest safe cases are translated to Spanish. No real credentials, harmful operational requests, external tools, or indirect/RAG content.

shen2024.title: “Do Anything Now”: Characterizing and Evaluating In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts on Large Language Models
shen2024.reported_content: 15,140 collected prompts; 1,405 labeled jailbreak in the complete study/release.
shen2024.license_note: Repository declares MIT. Prompts include material collected from third-party sites; no raw prompt text is copied into this corpus.

tensortrust2024.title: Tensor Trust: Interpretable Prompt Injection Attacks from an Online Game
tensortrust2024.reported_content: Paper distinguishes prompt extraction and prompt hijacking; its published dataset contains hundreds of thousands of attacks/defenses.
tensortrust2024.license_note: No explicit dataset license identified in the data repository; no rows or attack strings are copied.
tensortrust2024.role: Taxonomy for prompt extraction, output-prefix and interpretable attack families.

deepset.title: deepset/prompt-injections
deepset.version: Dataset card consulted 2026-11-17; 662 examples reported by the dataset authors.
deepset.reported_content: Binary labels distinguish prompt injection from legitimate requests; labels do not indicate success against the target model.
deepset.license_note: License metadata conflict: dataset page lists Apache-2.0 while file metadata lists CC-BY-4.0. No row text is reused.
deepset.role: Taxonomy/reference for distinguishing direct injection from ordinary input.

jailbreakhub.title: JailbreakHub
jailbreakhub.reported_content: 31 non-empty files in the audited Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT folders; mostly persona/system configurations.
jailbreakhub.license_note: No individual prompt source, experiment label or result is asserted from this collection; no raw prompt text is copied.
jailbreakhub.role: Exploratory taxonomy for persona, authority, override and output-format families only.

xstest2024.title: XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models
xstest2024.reported_content: 450 prompts, including safe examples and unsafe contrast examples. This corpus uses only safe-labeled IDs.
xstest2024.license_note: Repository declares CC BY 4.0 for prompts; selected prompts are translated/adapted into Spanish with attribution.
xstest2024.role: Benign controls to measure false-positive overblocking; not used as attack evidence.
xstest2024.attribution: Röttger et al. (2024), XSTest; IDs 1, 51, 101, 151, 201, 327, 376, 401. Spanish translation/adaptation is identified in each case.

jailbreakbench2024.title: JailbreakBench: An Open Robustness Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Language Models
jailbreakbench2024.reported_content: JBB-Behaviors includes 100 harmful and 100 benign behaviors; behavior goals are distinct from model-specific jailbreak artifacts.
jailbreakbench2024.license_note: Repository declares MIT; no entries are imported.
jailbreakbench2024.role: Comparator/reference for labeling behaviors separately from attack payloads.

harmbench2024.title: HarmBench: A Standardized Evaluation Framework for Automated Red Teaming and Robust Refusal
harmbench2024.license_note: Repository declares MIT; no behavior or attack text is imported.
harmbench2024.role: Methodological comparison; broader harmful-behavior scope than this canary benchmark.

bipia2023.title: Benchmarking and Defending Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks on Large Language Models
bipia2023.reported_content: Indirect injections embedded in external web, email, table, summary and code contexts.
bipia2023.license_note: README notes upstream data with distinct terms; no dataset files are imported.
bipia2023.role: Out-of-scope for direct single-turn input; candidate for a later contextual/RAG extension.

hackaprompt2023.title: HackAPrompt Dataset
hackaprompt2023.reported_content: More than 600,000 challenge submissions against models/settings from 2023.
hackaprompt2023.license_note: Dataset card declares MIT and notes submissions from a public competition portal; no rows imported.
hackaprompt2023.role: Future source for expanded tactic discovery; challenge-specific success labels are not treated as outcomes on this target.
